final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. That answer is owned by security@harborlight.example and is valid until 2027-11-16. Section 4.3 of the Access Control Policy agrees: access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day. No live check covers leaver deprovisioning, so this answer rests on the approved answer and policy only and wasn't checked against the live identity provider.
